snippet.title: Atari ST Longplay - Air Supply
snippet.description:
This shoot-em-up was released in 1990 by Magic Bytes and created by Detlef Pleiss and Markus Weichselbaum. 

Your mission is to fly over 8 landscapes, of which you can change the colour of with the "C" key (made easier if you play it with the keyboard, rather than the joystick).

You must shoot/dodge everything, while dropping-off air supplies at the "HELP" outposts. Once this is done, you get to fight an end-of-level boss, which can kill you instantly should you touch it. 

The game has all the usual features of a shooter, including power-ups, squadrons of attackers, and bonus stages.

I can see why it wasn't very popular, due to the extreme difficulty and flimsy controls. If you happen to drop your supplies at the wrong place, you're screwed and have to rely on luck to find any more (the same goes for extra fuel). If you run out of fuel, the whole game ends, regardless.

I hacked into this to get infinite lives, supplies, and no damage. Couldn't hack it for fuel. I only realised at Stage 4 that I no longer had infinite lives and had to complete the rest with only one!

Overall, it has some cool music to keep you going, and the bonus stages are fun. Lots of coffee required!

P.S. sorry about the mouse pointer getting stuck onscreen. Don't know why it does that.
